audience: recruiting teams that run hiring pipelines and candidates in Breezy HR

useCases.title: Review candidates in one stage
useCases.text: List the candidates of a position, filtered by stage, then read one profile with its resume link and score.

useCases.title: Check how a role is doing
useCases.text: Read a position summary with counts per stage, top sources and applications in the last 7 and 30 days.

useCases.title: Find a candidate across all roles
useCases.text: Search every candidate in the company by name, text or email, then read the activity of one candidate.

useCases.title: Move a candidate to another stage
useCases.text: Read the stages of a pipeline, then move one candidate to a stage. A Hired-type stage marks the candidate as hired.

useCases.title: Add an internal note to a candidate
useCases.text: Add a note to the activity of a candidate. Only the hiring team sees it, and the candidate never does.

useCases.title: Read a hiring report
useCases.text: Read a hiring report with the same numbers as the Reports page. Company reports need a company admin.
